gaps.explanation: p5 Total Governmental Funds 'Transfers from (to) other funds' prints the net 29,679 (General 2,272 + Street 34,736 + Debt Service (7,329)). detail[] records the transfers gross per fund/department: in General dept 7,206 (p14) + Street 34,736 (p11) = 41,942; out Community Center (4,934) (p15) + Debt Service (7,329) (p12) = (12,263). 41,942 - 12,263 = 29,679 = statement; the -12,263 gap is the gross transfers out. No fix.

No proprietary schedule; p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Sewer Fund, Water Fund and Landfill Fund columns. JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income + Gain on disposal of assets. Sewer 192,719+17,147+1,542+82,479 = 293,887; Water 234,506+2,628+2,610 = 239,744; Landfill 78,773+3,627 = 82,400; total 616,031 = statement 616,031 (0 + 616,031 = 616,031).
